acceptance: Design requirement (condenser datasheet and HEI calculation); contractual compliance through PG-02; ASME PTC 12.2 test for information
text: Design condenser pressure at base load and Site Reference Conditions (seawater 16.0 degC, 7 K rise): not more than 36 mbar(a). At the maximum seawater temperature (27.0 degC) the plant shall run at base load without load limitation; the back-pressure shall stay within the steam turbine continuous limits with margin to the alarm value.
title: Condenser pressure
